what_this_is: Email from Trillion's own address as a Workshop tool that runs in the account that runs Trillion (placement:this-account; src/mail-sender.mjs sendWrittenEmail through src/person-store.mjs accountActions). Every email is drawn by the shared email part in Trillion's look and sent from the sender src/mail-settings.json names; any other account's AI is told it cannot send from that address. What each email went out as is kept in the account's Sent (src/sent.mjs), through invoke.external_effect.sent.

payload.label: Send an email as Trillion
payload.job: Send one personal email to one person from Trillion's own address (user-51d1f203@example.com), in Trillion's branded email look, with an optional button
payload.description: Runs only in the account that runs Trillion. When emailing a person from contacts, read their current row and pass recipient as that row's name with its email address as to; a mismatch or ambiguous address is refused. The words are markdown (bold, links, lists); `action` adds one button with a label and a link; `reply_to` sends replies somewhere else. Returns whether it went out. Every email also goes as a BCC to the account owner's own address, and is kept in the account's Sent. Subscription emails use subscription fields for one-click unsubscribe and the visible footer; sender and postal address stay owned by the shared sender. The current consent source must establish eligibility.

to.description: The one email address it goes to

recipient.description: The intended person's name from their current contact row; required when to belongs to a saved contact

markdown.description: The words of the email, in markdown

preheader.description: The short line an inbox shows after the subject

reply_to.description: Where replies go, when not to the sender

unsubscribe_url.description: Current recipient HTTPS endpoint accepting RFC8058 one-click POST. Obtain from the consent owner immediately before sending.

list_id.description: The subscription list identity, for example Updates <updates.example.com>.

reason.description: The actual reason this recipient receives the subscription.

subscription.description: Adds RFC8058 List-Unsubscribe/List-Unsubscribe-Post and List-ID headers plus visible unsubscribe, reason and the sending owner’s postal address. Use the audience tool’s current eligibility rule; it does not infer consent from an address.

sent_copy.description: Exactly what went out, present when it was sent: to, from, reply_to, bcc, subject, preheader, markdown, text, html, sent_at, provider; subscription mail also keeps exact headers, footer_lines and footer_links.

recipient_resolution.description: The current contact list and row whose name and address matched, or that the address was not in contacts

unknown.description: The provider may have sent it; do not retry blindly.

suppressed.description: The provider refused this suppressed recipient; the shared audience owner retains do-not-send for this address.
